title: PixelKin - Battle: The Buzz
_note: The boss at the bottom of the cup (THE BUZZ, your own heartbeat with wings): the Wakeful Fair tune turned into a breakneck F-dorian fight at 176 — saw lead, eighth-note bass, brass stabs on 2 and 4, a pulse12 buzzing tremolo, four-on-the-floor kick. Classic-only like every battle cue.
